author: choconatto
quote: the soft-lock property is now always disabled regardless of its actual value.
capture_method: Read-only research worker directly inspected the primary post in the cloud browser DOM/accessibility tree and observed the Roblox Staff badge; this file is a short observation record, not an HTML/screenshot archive.

scope: HingeConstraint.SoftlockServoUponReachingTarget in the staff response to the reported hinge behavior.
limitations: Other softlock classes are not named; do not extrapolate this statement to CylindricalConstraint or SlidingBallConstraint.
